stories.title: FEMA chief Hamilton tells states to handle disasters on their own
stories.description: Hamilton said states should handle most disasters alone. POLITICO reports the administration plans to cut aid in as little as six months.

stories.title: Iran says Hormuz to stay shut until US accepts its plan
stories.description: Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said a seven-day initiative would reopen the strait, while Rubio called a deal extremely difficult.

stories.title: Gulf oil exports top prewar levels despite Iran attacks
stories.description: The rebound, above a 23.3 million-barrel prewar average, relies on U.S. naval escorts and pipelines bypassing the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Trump says he'll spend over $400 million to boost GOP
stories.description: With the Nov. 3 midterms two weeks away, Trump said he has already spent over $300 million and cited recent events in France.

stories.title: WSJ says Musk personally ordered Ukraine Starshield cap
stories.description: The report contradicts Musk's claim that limits are set by the military or president, as Trump denies ordering the speed caps.

stories.title: Anthropic draft S-1 shows $16.3B revenue, heavy losses
stories.description: The prospectus, seen by The Wall Street Journal, reveals an $80.7 billion first-half loss, mostly noncash charges, ahead of an expected November listing.

stories.title: Witkoff meets Zelenskyy in Oslo, to see Putin Wednesday
stories.description: The U.S. envoy will bring Putin proposals in St. Petersburg, including a possible three-way summit with Trump and Zelenskyy, Politico Europe reports.

stories.title: FAA certifies Boeing 737 Max 10 after years of delays
stories.description: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy announced the approval in Everett, Washington, meaning all four 737 Max models are now certified.

stories.title: RNC pumps $50 million into GOP House, Senate races
stories.description: The transfer, aided by a June Supreme Court ruling, widens the GOP's cash edge over a debt-burdened DNC before Nov. 3.

stories.title: Zelenskyy says US missile warnings resume after Rubio call
stories.description: The update followed Oslo talks with envoy Steve Witkoff, hours after Secretary of State Rubio called claims of withheld support "scandalous."

stories.title: ProPublica: FBI probe eyeing Graham, Clyburn stalled
stories.description: Agents examined a Navatek cash-for-contracts scheme, but the case stalled after Trump dismantled FBI public corruption teams and fired the investigating agents.

stories.title: Curfews calm French cities as unrest spreads across Europe
stories.description: Protest groups plan new demonstrations Saturday. Euro area inflation hit 3.8% in September, its highest level in three years.

stories.title: Albertans reject separation in referendum, boosting Carney
stories.description: About 76% voted to remain in Canada, per unofficial Elections Alberta results, as separatist leaders vowed their independence push would continue.

stories.title: Trump envoy tells Gulf allies US ending oil-for-security role
stories.description: In Doha, the Trump envoy urged Gulf allies to build regional security partnerships, saying Washington still wants an Iran peace deal.

stories.title: House Democrats plan Musk probes if they win majority
stories.description: Possible committee chairs are looking at DOGE cuts, SpaceX and Tesla federal contracts, and Starlink limits on Ukraine's military, Politico reports.

stories.title: Korean data-center company Elice plunges in Kosdaq debut
stories.description: The AI data-center company's shares closed far below their offer price despite huge investor demand, and Seoul's broader market fell with them.

stories.title: Iran's Guards say mines set two tankers ablaze near Hormuz
stories.description: The Revolutionary Guards said the ships used an unauthorized route. No independent maritime authority has confirmed the claim or named the vessels.

stories.title: OpenAI speeds up $30 billion raise before Anthropic IPO
stories.description: The round could value the ChatGPT maker above $1.4 trillion, with SoftBank and MGX among backers in talks, Reuters reports.

stories.title: Zelensky says Pentagon delays Patriots allies paid for
stories.description: Speaking to U.S. senators, Ukraine's president said Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth hasn't signed off on interceptors. Washington denies blocking the weapons.

stories.title: Vance declines to endorse Netanyahu, splitting with Trump
stories.description: Vance said he's focused on U.S. midterms and staying out of Israel's Oct. 27 vote, a day after Trump backed Netanyahu.

stories.title: Mahmoud Khalil asks Supreme Court to hear deportation case
stories.description: The Columbia graduate wants the court to overturn a 3rd Circuit ruling that his release challenge must first go through immigration courts.

stories.title: Brazil justices reach out to Bolsonaro camp before runoff
stories.description: Facing a possible Flávio Bolsonaro presidency and a hostile Senate, some justices have issued conciliatory rulings to avert impeachment, Bloomberg reports.

stories.title: Trump approval hits record-low 31%, Reuters/Ipsos finds
stories.description: Democrats lead Republicans 47% to 35% on the generic congressional ballot, the widest gap this cycle, as gas prices weigh on voters.

stories.title: Merz warns Europe is underestimating Russian threat
stories.description: Chancellor Merz told Bloomberg that Putin wants to weaken democracy across the continent, not just defeat Ukraine.

stories.title: PM Lecornu orders partial curfews after weekend riots
stories.description: Prefects will impose local curfews from Monday evening. Lecornu ruled out a curfew covering all of Paris but said a state of emergency remains possible.

stories.title: Trump open to Xi, Putin summit focused on nuclear arms
stories.description: Trump said talks should center on denuclearization, not Ukraine, after the Kremlin floated a meeting at November's APEC summit in Shenzhen.

stories.title: Earhart expedition finds Nikumaroro object was trees
stories.description: Purdue and the Archaeological Legacy Institute found no conclusive evidence of Earhart's Electra in the lagoon but say castaway theory stands.

stories.title: Iran MP says Mojtaba Khamenei's nuclear fatwa will differ
stories.description: Lawmaker Ahmad Naderi called for revisiting Ali Khamenei's ban on atomic weapons. Officials also threatened heavier retaliation if US-Israeli strikes resume.

stories.title: Judge sees 'bad faith' in Trump golf course tree cutting
stories.description: Judge Ana Reyes questioned the government's claim that mass tree removals at East Potomac Park were unrelated to Trump's planned golf course redesign.

stories.title: Macron vows rioters will pay after worst unrest in years
stories.description: In a televised address, the French president promised "full transparency" on policing after nearly 2,400 arrests and almost 1,000 officers injured Saturday.

stories.title: Carney says 4 killed, dozens hurt in fire at Canadian military base
stories.description: The official toll is lower than media reports of seven dead. The RCMP is investigating Saturday's fire and explosion.

stories.title: Obama calls Trump probe of Rep. Ilhan Omar 'appalling'
stories.description: The former president says the administration is targeting Omar for criticizing Trump, six days after federal agents searched her Washington home.

stories.title: Rubio urges Israel to crack down on settler violence
stories.description: Rubio's comments followed video of masked settlers beating Washington Post photographer Heidi Levine during an olive harvest attack in the West Bank.

stories.title: Bend shooter was former Silver Rail student, police say
stories.description: Officials say the 16-year-old killed three children and a teacher in one classroom, using a shotgun his mother bought in August.

stories.title: Trump's doctor never more than 3 minutes away, WSJ reports
stories.description: The Journal's profile of Dr. Sean Barbabella, a Navy captain, describes a patient who doesn't always follow advice, including on daily aspirin.

stories.title: AI-generated midterm ads hit $137 million, Wesleyan finds
stories.description: Researchers flagged more than 220 AI-made ads, mostly from Republican-aligned sponsors, with spending up from about $80 million in early September.

stories.title: Ukraine runs out of Patriot interceptors, CNN reports
stories.description: A source told CNN that almost all ballistic missiles in Russia's latest strike got through because Ukraine had no interceptors left.

stories.title: Zelenskyy talks with Trump envoys on new peace meeting
stories.description: Zelenskyy said the call covered next steps after talks in Florida, as Washington floats a three-way summit with Putin.

stories.title: FAA, controllers' union agree on 2.8% raise, badge-in rule
stories.description: The raise takes effect Oct. 18, retroactive to January, and controllers must badge in and out to curb leaving shifts early.

stories.title: FEC filings show Musk's $158 million flowed to Paxton race
stories.description: Each time Musk sent a September check, the Senate Leadership Fund passed the same amount to Texas PAC within a day, paying for a Texas Senate ad blitz.

stories.title: Trump endorses Netanyahu nine days before Israel election
stories.description: Trump said anyone other than Bibi would be the wrong leader, warning America would otherwise have to confront Iran on its own.

stories.title: US producer prices post biggest jump in over four years
stories.description: Wholesale prices rose 1.3% in September, more than double forecasts, a day after hotter-than-expected CPI data raised pressure on the Fed.

stories.title: DOJ sues California over alleged noncitizen mail ballots
stories.description: The suit asks a judge to bar California from counting mail ballots from people it calls likely noncitizens until citizenship is confirmed.

stories.title: Report details how Hegseth's execution livestream imploded
stories.description: Officials told The Atlantic the plan sparked "pretty universal revulsion" before Trump scrapped it Thursday; Nidal Hasan's Dec. 3 execution stands.

stories.title: FBI probes suspicious letters mailed to Congress offices
stories.description: An alert to Capitol Hill staff Thursday followed white-powder mailings to election offices in Louisiana, Oklahoma and Ohio weeks before Election Day.

stories.title: North Korea tests sub-launched strategic cruise missiles
stories.description: The east coast launches, reported by KCNA on Thursday, marked Pyongyang's first underwater missile test in nearly three years, according to AP.

stories.title: Zacharia ousted as press secretary after 5 days
stories.description: Her exit follows a 14-minute debut briefing and admissions she never passed the bar, despite Trump calling her an attorney.

stories.title: Eutelsat soars after Ukraine reports Starlink speed cap
stories.description: Investors bet on European satellite providers, but analysts warn Europe lacks a ready alternative for Ukrainian drones, with IRIS² years away.

stories.title: Prosecutors seek life sentences for Alexander brothers
stories.description: Defense lawyers want 15-year minimum terms for the luxury brokers convicted of sex trafficking. The judge will sentence them Oct. 27.

stories.title: No Kings rallies shift to early voting before midterms
stories.description: Organizers of the anti-Trump coalition held more than 2,500 events Saturday, urging supporters to cast ballots early and train as poll watchers.

stories.title: US sends hundreds of troops to Latin America in drug fight
stories.description: The first troops from a 10th Mountain Division battalion have started deploying to a new jungle site in Panama before drills in Colombia, officials say.

stories.title: Judge limited DOJ access to Omar's records before search
stories.description: Magistrate Judge Matthew Sharbaugh ordered screening to shield the Minnesota Democrat's legislative work under the Speech or Debate Clause, CNN reports.

stories.title: Nine fired FBI staff sue Patel over Trump documents probe
stories.description: The 70-page suit calls their February firings "political retribution" and asks for reinstatement, back pay and a ruling that the firings were unlawful.

stories.title: Eight states sue OpenAI, alleging ChatGPT harms children
stories.description: Iowa, Kansas and six other states filed separate suits seeking ChatGPT changes for minors and forfeiture of profits from young users.

stories.title: Two ships sink near Hormuz as Iranian attacks intensify
stories.description: Singapore says the GFS Pride sank after a projectile strike. The Cape Dao, a bulk carrier hit in September, also went down.

stories.title: Israel blocks Trump peace board's Gaza base, report says
stories.description: Contractors remain barred from Gaza two months after the contract was awarded, stalling an outpost seen as key to rebuilding.

stories.title: Supreme Court blocks order forcing FCC ad rate ruling
stories.description: The 7-2 order lets the FCC set its own schedule, stalling Democrats' challenge to cheaper ad rates for party committees.

stories.title: Houthi missile strikes Saudi Aramco headquarters in Dhahran
stories.description: Energy Ministry reported no injuries after the late Tuesday attack, which followed Saudi-led strikes on Sanaa and Houthi threats of retaliation.

stories.title: US military weighs 'mother of all bombs' for Iran strikes
stories.description: Plans target Iranian energy and nuclear sites if Trump resumes combat, though sources doubt the bomb can penetrate Pickaxe Mountain.

stories.title: DOJ subpoenas Omar's relatives in immigration probe
stories.description: Grand jury subpoenas, including one to her sister Sahra Noor, came a day after federal agents searched Omar's Washington home.

stories.title: FBI arrests OpenAI engineer over hidden recording device
stories.description: Prosecutors say Saudi national Abdulrahman Alfozan hid a recorder in an executive meeting room. OpenAI says its AI models traced him.

stories.title: Vatican says Pope Leo XIV has lung cancer after surgery
stories.description: Surgeons at Rome's Gemelli hospital removed the lower lobe of the 71-year-old pontiff's right lung, and the Vatican reported no complications.

stories.title: Germany, UK urge tougher Russia sanctions after Trump deal
stories.description: Foreign ministers Wadephul and Miliband spoke in Warsaw a day after Merz called Trump's Russian diesel deal "out of the question."

stories.title: Guilfoyle resigns as ambassador to Greece, denies claims
stories.description: The White House asked her to step down after Wall Street Journal reports of alleged misconduct. Guilfoyle says the allegations are false.

stories.title: Egypt presses Iran to halt attacks on Saudi Arabia
stories.description: Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty told Iran's Abbas Araghchi the strikes are unjustified, after a Houthi attack on Riyadh's airport killed 13 Saturday.

stories.title: Paxton partied in Dubai with indicted executives, WSJ reports
stories.description: Video shows the Republican Senate nominee with two healthcare fraud defendants, including a $190,000 donor, as he trails Democrat James Talarico in polls.

stories.title: Iran fortifies nuclear sites, hints at Gulf incursions
stories.description: The Wall Street Journal reports that Iran is preparing for possible U.S. strikes after the Nov. 3 midterms and warning of wider regional escalation.

stories.title: Bulgaria summons Russian envoy after drone sinks ship
stories.description: Eleven sailors from the HS Dignity are missing after the second deadly sinking near Bulgarian waters in a week.

stories.title: Zacharia ends first White House briefing after 14 minutes
stories.description: The new press secretary took questions from three conservative outlets and announced that Ambassador Kimberly Guilfoyle had been asked to resign.

stories.title: Netanyahu seeks Saudi nod to strike Houthis; MBS objects
stories.description: Mohammed bin Salman fears public backlash over Israeli involvement, Haaretz reports, as Houthi missiles hit Riyadh's airport, killing at least 13.

stories.title: Trump says he may meet Kim Jong Un on November Asia trip
stories.description: No meeting has been scheduled. Trump will attend the APEC summit in Shenzhen, China, on Nov. 18-19 and says he gets along with Kim.

stories.title: Rachel floods Las Vegas after pounding Southern California
stories.description: Long Beach red-tagged 13 beachfront residences as Rachel's surf hit, while knee-deep water flooded areas near the Las Vegas Strip.

stories.title: UK blames Iran's Revolutionary Guard for air base plot
stories.description: Britain sanctioned two Iranians and summoned Tehran's envoy over the RAF Fairford incident; Iran denies involvement, and no one has been charged.

stories.title: Taxpayer-funded Trump ads aired after judge's deadline
stories.description: AdImpact data shows two spots ran into early Monday after Judge Jennifer Rochon ordered the administration Sunday to cancel remaining ads.

stories.title: Meta unveils Muse Wonder, says it matches top AI rivals
stories.description: The new models are a key test of Zuckerberg's multibillion-dollar rebuild of Meta's AI operation. Meta shares rose after the launch.

stories.title: Hall and Woodford win Nobel economics prize
stories.description: The Stanford and Columbia economists were honored for models central banks and governments use to time policy and soften booms and recessions.

stories.title: NATO's top commander warns Russia attack would be futile
stories.description: Gen. Alexus Grynkewich outlined a "theory of victory" he says all 32 allies back, pledging to hit anything sustaining an attacking force.

stories.title: US threatens Ukraine intel, arms cutoff over energy strikes
stories.description: The warnings came as Trump announced an "energy ceasefire" that Kyiv said it knew nothing about. Russia later hit a Kharkiv power plant.

stories.title: UK PM Burnham says Russia interfered in Brexit vote
stories.description: It's the first time a British prime minister has made the claim, though Burnham offered no evidence or details.

stories.title: Saudi crown prince shuttles between bunkers, WSJ reports
stories.description: Mohammed bin Salman hasn't appeared publicly since Oct. 6 as Houthi strikes on Riyadh's airport killed 13 Saturday and one Sunday.

stories.title: US offered Russia frozen assets for limited truce, NYT says
stories.description: Envoys Witkoff and Kushner also floated a Lukoil stake sale and Belarus potash relief; Kyiv demanded matching payments and guarantees.

stories.title: Djibouti migrant boat capsizes, death toll rises to 139, UN says
stories.description: The Yemen-bound boat carried about 305 people, mostly Ethiopians; 84 remain missing as Djiboutian authorities continue searching, the IOM said.

stories.title: State Department watchdog probes Ambassador Guilfoyle
stories.description: The inquiry follows Trump donor Eric Deters' claim that Guilfoyle sought $100,000 for her credit card bill in exchange for administration access.

stories.title: Pentagon raises US troop death toll in Iran war to 21
stories.description: The count adds two noncombat deaths, weeks after Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth called a Washington Post undercount report "a complete lie."

stories.title: Delhi Police detain thousands to foil 'Cockroach' rally
stories.description: Police pulled CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke off a flight as authorities sealed Delhi against a rally demanding the election chief's resignation.

stories.title: Germany rebuffs Trump, backs Zelenskyy and Russia sanctions
stories.description: Foreign Minister Wadephul said Sunday that Putin needs more pressure, after Berlin vowed Saturday to keep sanctions despite Trump easing Russian diesel curbs.

stories.title: Christa Pike returns to prison after surviving execution
stories.description: Her attorneys say the Tennessee inmate, who survived two pentobarbital doses Sept. 30, is receiving medical care at the Nashville women's prison.

stories.title: Isaias makes landfall near Destin, knocking out power
stories.description: The Category 2 storm came ashore with 105 mph winds Friday night, toppling trees and leaving hundreds of thousands without power.

stories.title: Putin relays Iran's peace proposal to Trump, Kremlin says
stories.description: Kremlin spokesman Peskov gave no details of Tehran's terms or Trump's response, saying Ukraine dominated the Friday call.

stories.title: White House orders AI firms to report security incidents
stories.description: The Super Intelligence Force acted after Anthropic disclosed its test models submitted visa applications and a false Philadelphia murder tip.

stories.title: US sanctions ICC itself hours after ex-judge wins Nobel
stories.description: Rubio says the measures ban US transactions with the court; a six-month grace period lets member states keep funding operations.

stories.title: Trump rules out Iran strikes before Nov. 3 midterms
stories.description: Trump cited "productive discussions" with Tehran but said the naval blockade stays, after reports the Pentagon was drafting pre-election strike options.

stories.title: Magnitude 7.7 quake topples buildings in central Panama
stories.description: No casualties were immediately reported as tsunami warnings for Latin America's Pacific coast were lifted and the Panama Canal kept operating normally.

stories.title: US pledges tens of millions to UN agencies in Geneva
stories.description: Diplomats say the pledges to weather and wildlife agencies show Washington still wants a role in the UN despite deep funding cuts.

stories.title: Justice Department halts silencer registration nationwide
stories.description: The ATF guidance follows a Texas judge's August ruling against parts of the 1934 National Firearms Act, which officials didn't appeal.

stories.title: AI firms plan for public revolt after catastrophic event
stories.description: Anthropic and OpenAI executives are gaming out scenarios, and many insiders told Axios they expect an incident within six to 12 months.

stories.title: Trump administration opposes all UN chief candidates
stories.description: Washington holds a Security Council veto and wants a "disruptor" and new contenders, officials told Politico, ahead of Guterres' Dec. 31 exit.

stories.title: DHS refuses to pause ICE in New York after Bronx shooting
stories.description: Secretary Markwayne Mullin rejected pleas from Gov. Kathy Hochul and Mayor Zohran Mamdani after an agent shot a man near his child.

stories.title: South African judge Navi Pillay wins Nobel Peace Prize
stories.description: The Norwegian Nobel Committee honored the former UN human rights chief, who once defended Nelson Mandela, for promoting peace and international law.

stories.title: Zelenskyy accuses US of inaction after strikes kill 78
stories.description: Ukraine's president faulted Washington for pursuing business with Moscow while calling the war a stalemate, as his negotiators head to US talks.

stories.title: Trump forms committee to probe Fed Governor Lisa Cook
stories.description: The panel will weigh mortgage-related allegations Nov. 5 at the White House after the Supreme Court blocked Trump's earlier firing attempt.

stories.title: SoftBank seeks up to $100B from Gulf investors, FT says
stories.description: Masayoshi Son has held talks in the UAE about a fund to buy companies and revamp them with AI, the Financial Times reports.

stories.title: Thousands march in Madrid after evicted pensioner Maricarmen's death
stories.description: The 87-year-old, whose eviction sparked nationwide housing protests and a Nov. 29 snap election, died Wednesday before she could return home.

stories.title: Pentagon drafts three-day Iran strike plan as Trump waits
stories.description: The plans came to light the same day Trump said the U.S. won't attack Iran before the Nov. 3 midterms, citing "productive discussions."

stories.title: Judge orders return of man deported to Equatorial Guinea
stories.description: Trump-appointed Judge John Hinderaker ruled Ahmed Soliman's April removal violated due process; he has been jailed incommunicado after speaking out about abuse.

stories.title: OpenAI revenue $20bn below earlier signals, FT reports
stories.description: The report, citing documents shared with investors, sent AI-linked stocks lower Thursday, with Oracle among the hardest hit.

stories.title: Trump bought SpaceX debt days before signing space policy
stories.description: Filing released Thursday shows up to $5 million in SpaceX notes bought Aug. 18; the White House says Trump doesn't direct trades.

stories.title: DOJ seeks indictment of Cassidy Hutchinson over Jan. 6
stories.description: Prosecutors presented evidence to a grand jury Tuesday over allegations she lied to Congress, according to Punchbowl News and NBC News.

stories.title: US suspends Microsoft, Adobe from green card program
stories.description: Vice President Vance accused Microsoft of abusing the system, while the Labor Department also suspended Infosys, Tata, Wipro and other outsourcing firms.

stories.title: USS Abraham Lincoln heads home after 321-day Iran war tour
stories.description: The carrier is due at Naval Air Station North Island Thursday, a day after Hegseth gave its crew the Presidential Unit Citation.

stories.title: Judge extends block on Trump's White House media ban
stories.description: Judge Kelly will rule by Tuesday on keeping CNN, MS NOW and Politico's access, calling the national security defense an "uphill climb."

stories.title: Rubio calls Ukraine war a stalemate, says peace elusive
stories.description: The U.S. secretary of state blamed Russia's demand for all of Donetsk as a Russian diplomat said no U.S.-mediated talks are planned.

stories.title: ICE amassed nearly 100 million records in voter fraud hunt
stories.description: Documents released Wednesday by Democracy Forward show ICE investigators also reviewed dozens of nonprofits and weighed using undercover agents.

stories.title: US charges Maduro, wife Flores with torture conspiracy
stories.description: A superseding indictment unsealed in Manhattan accuses the couple of torturing opponents and Americans; a judge separately denied Flores' bail request.

stories.title: Xi rebuffed Trump plea to talk with Takaichi, report says
stories.description: Trump also pressed Beijing to ease rare earth curbs on Japan, but Xi warned of Japanese militarism, sources told the Post.

stories.title: Hegseth gives USS Lincoln top award before homecoming
stories.description: The carrier will return to San Diego Thursday after a 321-day Iran war deployment marked by reported supply shortages and crew strain.

stories.title: Rubio denies US is blocking Machado's return to Venezuela
stories.description: In Athens, Rubio rejected a Wall Street Journal report while the Nobel laureate vows to return after repeated blocked attempts.

stories.title: ICE agent shoots man in car with child in NYC
stories.description: The man was hospitalized and conscious. Mayor Mamdani says he'll demand President Trump end all ICE enforcement actions in New York City.

stories.title: Ukraine's Vivaldi offensive derails Russian Donbas push
stories.description: Finland's Black Bird Group says September was Russia's worst month for net territorial losses since June 2023, contradicting Putin's claims of inevitable conquest.

stories.title: Gaza death toll tops 74,000 as war hits three-year mark
stories.description: Gaza's Health Ministry says 1,462 were killed after the October 2025 ceasefire took effect, and UN data shows many households living in tents.

stories.title: DOJ says Trump likely to reissue Harvard international student ban
stories.description: A Justice Department lawyer told the 1st Circuit that White House officials signaled a new ban if the court lifts Judge Burroughs' order.

stories.title: Putin adds $60B to war budget as talks stall, report says
stories.description: Bloomberg's sources say Russia's 2026 defense spending will reach nearly 17 trillion rubles, about 40% above plan, after Putin decided US-brokered talks had failed.

stories.title: Kagan, Soai win Nobel chemistry prize for mirror molecules
stories.description: The French and Japanese chemists were honored for explaining how one mirror-image form can dominate, work the academy calls decisive for drugmaking.

stories.title: Trump wants new Camp David at his West Palm Beach club
stories.description: Under the plan reported by The Washington Post, the federal government would receive part of the property while the rest stays private.

stories.title: Israel marks 3 years since Oct. 7 attack, weeks before vote
stories.description: Survivors and bereaved families led dawn ceremonies at the Nova festival site, the first anniversary since the ceasefire with all hostages returned.

stories.title: Russia strikes Kyiv hours after Zelensky's attack warning
stories.description: Explosions rocked central Kyiv early Oct. 7, Putin's 74th birthday, after Ukraine's Air Force tracked Russian strategic bombers heading toward Ukraine.

stories.title: Kremlin says no Trump call agreed on Siberia plague death
stories.description: Trump said Tuesday he would discuss a Russian lab worker's suspected pneumonic plague death with Putin. Russia hasn't confirmed plague caused it.

stories.title: US military to halt Okinawa operations, impose curfew
stories.description: The 48-hour pause and alcohol ban begin Wednesday, followed by a 30-day curfew, after a Marine's arrest over a Naha woman's killing.

stories.title: United, Delta recover after outage hits apps, boarding
stories.description: United blamed an outside vendor for a glitch that blocked MileagePlus logins. Delta cited a global data connectivity issue that delayed boarding.

stories.title: Trump weighs suspending federal gas tax before midterms
stories.description: Waiving the 18.4-cent tax would require Congress to act, but lawmakers aren't expected to return before the November elections.

stories.title: US moves Reaper drones from Africa to Colombia, Ecuador
stories.description: Two U.S. officials said the strike drones will support an expanding anti-cartel campaign that commanders say could move from sea to land.

stories.title: Large fire engulfs oil tanker off Russia's Sochi coast
stories.description: Some media reports point to a possible drone attack. Russian authorities have not given a cause or said whether anyone was hurt.

stories.title: Trump says nobody knows who's running Iran as talks stall
stories.description: Vice President Vance echoed the uncertainty, telling Reuters any deal ending the eight-month war requires Iran to meaningfully cut nuclear enrichment.

stories.title: Justice Alito says he'll stay even if Democrats win Senate
stories.description: The 76-year-old justice, promoting his first book, dismissed speculation that he would retire early so Trump could confirm a conservative successor.

stories.title: FBI whistleblower says White House pushed protester probe
stories.description: Former FBI analyst Jill Fields says in a complaint to Senate leaders that officials ordered investigations of Los Angeles anti-ICE protesters despite free speech protections.

stories.title: Sen. Murphy says Pentagon barred him from Qatar base
stories.description: The Connecticut Democrat called it an effort to hide Iran war costs and said the Pentagon refused to brief him.

stories.title: Judge blocks Trump's fines of up to $1.8M on migrants
stories.description: A Boston judge ruled the government unlawfully penalized migrants who stayed after deportation orders, faulting vague forms and skipped public comment.

stories.title: Paramount closes $110B Warner Bros. deal to form Skydance
stories.description: CEO David Ellison now controls Paramount, Warner Bros., CBS, CNN and HBO Max as the combined company's shares begin trading under SKYD.

stories.title: France test-fires new nuclear missile as Macron watches
stories.description: The unarmed M51.3 was launched from the submarine Le Vigilant off Brittany. Macron called the test proof of France's deterrent amid Russia tensions.

stories.title: Rubio assures Iceland US has no designs on the island
stories.description: Opening a NATO tour, the secretary of state said Washington is open to a bigger military role, but only with Iceland's consent.

stories.title: KFF poll finds record two-thirds back Medicare for All
stories.description: Support has risen from 53% in 2020, and independents and Republicans account for much of the gain, less than a month before the Nov. 3 midterms.

stories.title: Francis Halzen wins physics Nobel for cosmic neutrino find
stories.description: The University of Wisconsin–Madison physicist leads IceCube, a South Pole detector that first spotted high-energy neutrinos arriving from beyond our galaxy.

stories.title: Lithuania offers to pay for US base as Trump weighs idea
stories.description: Prime Minister Mindaugas Sinkevicius said Vilnius will cover costs if Washington decides to station troops permanently, though officials say no decision exists yet.

stories.title: Germany arrests ex-spy chief Hanning in espionage probe
stories.description: Prosecutors allege August Hanning, who led the BND spy agency until 2005, passed political information to another country's intelligence service.

stories.title: Brazil's Federal Police probe alleged US election meddling
stories.description: Inquiry targets a reported $1 million US grant for Supreme Court critics as Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro head to a runoff.

stories.title: Trump suggests Iran 'take out' LA, San Diego, drawing fury
stories.description: Speaking in Nebraska Monday, Trump called it a "small price to pay" for the Iran war; Newsom called him "deranged and dangerous."

stories.title: Justice Department files to strip 40 people of citizenship
stories.description: Attorney General Todd Blanche called the filings the largest denaturalization effort in modern history, targeting naturalized citizens accused of serious crimes.

stories.title: US warns Americans in Saudi Arabia of drone, missile risk
stories.description: The alert comes as Houthi rebels in Yemen claim missile and drone strikes on Riyadh's main airport and an Aramco refinery.

stories.title: Pentagon says it has stopped using Anthropic's AI tools
stories.description: The statement came after the Pentagon missed its own late-August deadline. Sources told the BBC that Anthropic's Claude AI was still in use last week.

stories.title: Reuters finds 40 LGBT migrants deported to hostile nations
stories.description: The investigation comes after the Supreme Court let the Trump administration resume third-country deportations pending December arguments.

top.title: FEMA chief Hamilton tells states to handle disasters on their own
top.description: Hamilton said states should handle most disasters alone. POLITICO reports the administration plans to cut aid in as little as six months.

top.title: Iran says Hormuz to stay shut until US accepts its plan
top.description: Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said a seven-day initiative would reopen the strait, while Rubio called a deal extremely difficult.

top.title: Gulf oil exports top prewar levels despite Iran attacks
top.description: The rebound, above a 23.3 million-barrel prewar average, relies on U.S. naval escorts and pipelines bypassing the Strait of Hormuz.

top.title: Trump says he'll spend over $400 million to boost GOP
top.description: With the Nov. 3 midterms two weeks away, Trump said he has already spent over $300 million and cited recent events in France.

top.title: WSJ says Musk personally ordered Ukraine Starshield cap
top.description: The report contradicts Musk's claim that limits are set by the military or president, as Trump denies ordering the speed caps.

top.title: Anthropic draft S-1 shows $16.3B revenue, heavy losses
top.description: The prospectus, seen by The Wall Street Journal, reveals an $80.7 billion first-half loss, mostly noncash charges, ahead of an expected November listing.

top.title: Witkoff meets Zelenskyy in Oslo, to see Putin Wednesday
top.description: The U.S. envoy will bring Putin proposals in St. Petersburg, including a possible three-way summit with Trump and Zelenskyy, Politico Europe reports.

top.title: FAA certifies Boeing 737 Max 10 after years of delays
top.description: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy announced the approval in Everett, Washington, meaning all four 737 Max models are now certified.

top.title: RNC pumps $50 million into GOP House, Senate races
top.description: The transfer, aided by a June Supreme Court ruling, widens the GOP's cash edge over a debt-burdened DNC before Nov. 3.

top.title: Zelenskyy says US missile warnings resume after Rubio call
top.description: The update followed Oslo talks with envoy Steve Witkoff, hours after Secretary of State Rubio called claims of withheld support "scandalous."

top.title: ProPublica: FBI probe eyeing Graham, Clyburn stalled
top.description: Agents examined a Navatek cash-for-contracts scheme, but the case stalled after Trump dismantled FBI public corruption teams and fired the investigating agents.

top.title: Curfews calm French cities as unrest spreads across Europe
top.description: Protest groups plan new demonstrations Saturday. Euro area inflation hit 3.8% in September, its highest level in three years.

top.title: Albertans reject separation in referendum, boosting Carney
top.description: About 76% voted to remain in Canada, per unofficial Elections Alberta results, as separatist leaders vowed their independence push would continue.

top.title: Trump envoy tells Gulf allies US ending oil-for-security role
top.description: In Doha, the Trump envoy urged Gulf allies to build regional security partnerships, saying Washington still wants an Iran peace deal.

top.title: House Democrats plan Musk probes if they win majority
top.description: Possible committee chairs are looking at DOGE cuts, SpaceX and Tesla federal contracts, and Starlink limits on Ukraine's military, Politico reports.

top.title: Korean data-center company Elice plunges in Kosdaq debut
top.description: The AI data-center company's shares closed far below their offer price despite huge investor demand, and Seoul's broader market fell with them.

top.title: Iran's Guards say mines set two tankers ablaze near Hormuz
top.description: The Revolutionary Guards said the ships used an unauthorized route. No independent maritime authority has confirmed the claim or named the vessels.

top.title: OpenAI speeds up $30 billion raise before Anthropic IPO
top.description: The round could value the ChatGPT maker above $1.4 trillion, with SoftBank and MGX among backers in talks, Reuters reports.

top.title: Zelensky says Pentagon delays Patriots allies paid for
top.description: Speaking to U.S. senators, Ukraine's president said Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth hasn't signed off on interceptors. Washington denies blocking the weapons.

top.title: Vance declines to endorse Netanyahu, splitting with Trump
top.description: Vance said he's focused on U.S. midterms and staying out of Israel's Oct. 27 vote, a day after Trump backed Netanyahu.

top.title: Mahmoud Khalil asks Supreme Court to hear deportation case
top.description: The Columbia graduate wants the court to overturn a 3rd Circuit ruling that his release challenge must first go through immigration courts.

top.title: Brazil justices reach out to Bolsonaro camp before runoff
top.description: Facing a possible Flávio Bolsonaro presidency and a hostile Senate, some justices have issued conciliatory rulings to avert impeachment, Bloomberg reports.

top.title: Trump approval hits record-low 31%, Reuters/Ipsos finds
top.description: Democrats lead Republicans 47% to 35% on the generic congressional ballot, the widest gap this cycle, as gas prices weigh on voters.

top.title: Merz warns Europe is underestimating Russian threat
top.description: Chancellor Merz told Bloomberg that Putin wants to weaken democracy across the continent, not just defeat Ukraine.

top.title: PM Lecornu orders partial curfews after weekend riots
top.description: Prefects will impose local curfews from Monday evening. Lecornu ruled out a curfew covering all of Paris but said a state of emergency remains possible.

top.title: Trump open to Xi, Putin summit focused on nuclear arms
top.description: Trump said talks should center on denuclearization, not Ukraine, after the Kremlin floated a meeting at November's APEC summit in Shenzhen.

top.title: Earhart expedition finds Nikumaroro object was trees
top.description: Purdue and the Archaeological Legacy Institute found no conclusive evidence of Earhart's Electra in the lagoon but say castaway theory stands.

top.title: Iran MP says Mojtaba Khamenei's nuclear fatwa will differ
top.description: Lawmaker Ahmad Naderi called for revisiting Ali Khamenei's ban on atomic weapons. Officials also threatened heavier retaliation if US-Israeli strikes resume.

top.title: Judge sees 'bad faith' in Trump golf course tree cutting
top.description: Judge Ana Reyes questioned the government's claim that mass tree removals at East Potomac Park were unrelated to Trump's planned golf course redesign.

top.title: Macron vows rioters will pay after worst unrest in years
top.description: In a televised address, the French president promised "full transparency" on policing after nearly 2,400 arrests and almost 1,000 officers injured Saturday.

top.title: Carney says 4 killed, dozens hurt in fire at Canadian military base
top.description: The official toll is lower than media reports of seven dead. The RCMP is investigating Saturday's fire and explosion.

top.title: Obama calls Trump probe of Rep. Ilhan Omar 'appalling'
top.description: The former president says the administration is targeting Omar for criticizing Trump, six days after federal agents searched her Washington home.

top.title: Rubio urges Israel to crack down on settler violence
top.description: Rubio's comments followed video of masked settlers beating Washington Post photographer Heidi Levine during an olive harvest attack in the West Bank.

top.title: Bend shooter was former Silver Rail student, police say
top.description: Officials say the 16-year-old killed three children and a teacher in one classroom, using a shotgun his mother bought in August.

top.title: Trump's doctor never more than 3 minutes away, WSJ reports
top.description: The Journal's profile of Dr. Sean Barbabella, a Navy captain, describes a patient who doesn't always follow advice, including on daily aspirin.

top.title: AI-generated midterm ads hit $137 million, Wesleyan finds
top.description: Researchers flagged more than 220 AI-made ads, mostly from Republican-aligned sponsors, with spending up from about $80 million in early September.

top.title: Ukraine runs out of Patriot interceptors, CNN reports
top.description: A source told CNN that almost all ballistic missiles in Russia's latest strike got through because Ukraine had no interceptors left.

top.title: Zelenskyy talks with Trump envoys on new peace meeting
top.description: Zelenskyy said the call covered next steps after talks in Florida, as Washington floats a three-way summit with Putin.

top.title: FAA, controllers' union agree on 2.8% raise, badge-in rule
top.description: The raise takes effect Oct. 18, retroactive to January, and controllers must badge in and out to curb leaving shifts early.

top.title: FEC filings show Musk's $158 million flowed to Paxton race
top.description: Each time Musk sent a September check, the Senate Leadership Fund passed the same amount to Texas PAC within a day, paying for a Texas Senate ad blitz.

top.title: Trump endorses Netanyahu nine days before Israel election
top.description: Trump said anyone other than Bibi would be the wrong leader, warning America would otherwise have to confront Iran on its own.

top.title: US producer prices post biggest jump in over four years
top.description: Wholesale prices rose 1.3% in September, more than double forecasts, a day after hotter-than-expected CPI data raised pressure on the Fed.

top.title: DOJ sues California over alleged noncitizen mail ballots
top.description: The suit asks a judge to bar California from counting mail ballots from people it calls likely noncitizens until citizenship is confirmed.

top.title: Report details how Hegseth's execution livestream imploded
top.description: Officials told The Atlantic the plan sparked "pretty universal revulsion" before Trump scrapped it Thursday; Nidal Hasan's Dec. 3 execution stands.

top.title: FBI probes suspicious letters mailed to Congress offices
top.description: An alert to Capitol Hill staff Thursday followed white-powder mailings to election offices in Louisiana, Oklahoma and Ohio weeks before Election Day.

top.title: North Korea tests sub-launched strategic cruise missiles
top.description: The east coast launches, reported by KCNA on Thursday, marked Pyongyang's first underwater missile test in nearly three years, according to AP.

top.title: Zacharia ousted as press secretary after 5 days
top.description: Her exit follows a 14-minute debut briefing and admissions she never passed the bar, despite Trump calling her an attorney.

top.title: Eutelsat soars after Ukraine reports Starlink speed cap
top.description: Investors bet on European satellite providers, but analysts warn Europe lacks a ready alternative for Ukrainian drones, with IRIS² years away.

top.title: Prosecutors seek life sentences for Alexander brothers
top.description: Defense lawyers want 15-year minimum terms for the luxury brokers convicted of sex trafficking. The judge will sentence them Oct. 27.

top.title: No Kings rallies shift to early voting before midterms
top.description: Organizers of the anti-Trump coalition held more than 2,500 events Saturday, urging supporters to cast ballots early and train as poll watchers.

top.title: US sends hundreds of troops to Latin America in drug fight
top.description: The first troops from a 10th Mountain Division battalion have started deploying to a new jungle site in Panama before drills in Colombia, officials say.

top.title: Judge limited DOJ access to Omar's records before search
top.description: Magistrate Judge Matthew Sharbaugh ordered screening to shield the Minnesota Democrat's legislative work under the Speech or Debate Clause, CNN reports.

top.title: Nine fired FBI staff sue Patel over Trump documents probe
top.description: The 70-page suit calls their February firings "political retribution" and asks for reinstatement, back pay and a ruling that the firings were unlawful.

top.title: Eight states sue OpenAI, alleging ChatGPT harms children
top.description: Iowa, Kansas and six other states filed separate suits seeking ChatGPT changes for minors and forfeiture of profits from young users.

top.title: Two ships sink near Hormuz as Iranian attacks intensify
top.description: Singapore says the GFS Pride sank after a projectile strike. The Cape Dao, a bulk carrier hit in September, also went down.

top.title: Israel blocks Trump peace board's Gaza base, report says
top.description: Contractors remain barred from Gaza two months after the contract was awarded, stalling an outpost seen as key to rebuilding.

top.title: Supreme Court blocks order forcing FCC ad rate ruling
top.description: The 7-2 order lets the FCC set its own schedule, stalling Democrats' challenge to cheaper ad rates for party committees.

top.title: Houthi missile strikes Saudi Aramco headquarters in Dhahran
top.description: Energy Ministry reported no injuries after the late Tuesday attack, which followed Saudi-led strikes on Sanaa and Houthi threats of retaliation.

top.title: US military weighs 'mother of all bombs' for Iran strikes
top.description: Plans target Iranian energy and nuclear sites if Trump resumes combat, though sources doubt the bomb can penetrate Pickaxe Mountain.

top.title: DOJ subpoenas Omar's relatives in immigration probe
top.description: Grand jury subpoenas, including one to her sister Sahra Noor, came a day after federal agents searched Omar's Washington home.

top.title: FBI arrests OpenAI engineer over hidden recording device
top.description: Prosecutors say Saudi national Abdulrahman Alfozan hid a recorder in an executive meeting room. OpenAI says its AI models traced him.

top.title: Vatican says Pope Leo XIV has lung cancer after surgery
top.description: Surgeons at Rome's Gemelli hospital removed the lower lobe of the 71-year-old pontiff's right lung, and the Vatican reported no complications.

top.title: Germany, UK urge tougher Russia sanctions after Trump deal
top.description: Foreign ministers Wadephul and Miliband spoke in Warsaw a day after Merz called Trump's Russian diesel deal "out of the question."

top.title: Guilfoyle resigns as ambassador to Greece, denies claims
top.description: The White House asked her to step down after Wall Street Journal reports of alleged misconduct. Guilfoyle says the allegations are false.

top.title: Egypt presses Iran to halt attacks on Saudi Arabia
top.description: Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty told Iran's Abbas Araghchi the strikes are unjustified, after a Houthi attack on Riyadh's airport killed 13 Saturday.

top.title: Paxton partied in Dubai with indicted executives, WSJ reports
top.description: Video shows the Republican Senate nominee with two healthcare fraud defendants, including a $190,000 donor, as he trails Democrat James Talarico in polls.

top.title: Iran fortifies nuclear sites, hints at Gulf incursions
top.description: The Wall Street Journal reports that Iran is preparing for possible U.S. strikes after the Nov. 3 midterms and warning of wider regional escalation.

top.title: Bulgaria summons Russian envoy after drone sinks ship
top.description: Eleven sailors from the HS Dignity are missing after the second deadly sinking near Bulgarian waters in a week.

top.title: Zacharia ends first White House briefing after 14 minutes
top.description: The new press secretary took questions from three conservative outlets and announced that Ambassador Kimberly Guilfoyle had been asked to resign.

top.title: Netanyahu seeks Saudi nod to strike Houthis; MBS objects
top.description: Mohammed bin Salman fears public backlash over Israeli involvement, Haaretz reports, as Houthi missiles hit Riyadh's airport, killing at least 13.

top.title: Trump says he may meet Kim Jong Un on November Asia trip
top.description: No meeting has been scheduled. Trump will attend the APEC summit in Shenzhen, China, on Nov. 18-19 and says he gets along with Kim.

top.title: Rachel floods Las Vegas after pounding Southern California
top.description: Long Beach red-tagged 13 beachfront residences as Rachel's surf hit, while knee-deep water flooded areas near the Las Vegas Strip.

top.title: UK blames Iran's Revolutionary Guard for air base plot
top.description: Britain sanctioned two Iranians and summoned Tehran's envoy over the RAF Fairford incident; Iran denies involvement, and no one has been charged.

top.title: Taxpayer-funded Trump ads aired after judge's deadline
top.description: AdImpact data shows two spots ran into early Monday after Judge Jennifer Rochon ordered the administration Sunday to cancel remaining ads.

top.title: Meta unveils Muse Wonder, says it matches top AI rivals
top.description: The new models are a key test of Zuckerberg's multibillion-dollar rebuild of Meta's AI operation. Meta shares rose after the launch.

top.title: Hall and Woodford win Nobel economics prize
top.description: The Stanford and Columbia economists were honored for models central banks and governments use to time policy and soften booms and recessions.

top.title: NATO's top commander warns Russia attack would be futile
top.description: Gen. Alexus Grynkewich outlined a "theory of victory" he says all 32 allies back, pledging to hit anything sustaining an attacking force.

top.title: US threatens Ukraine intel, arms cutoff over energy strikes
top.description: The warnings came as Trump announced an "energy ceasefire" that Kyiv said it knew nothing about. Russia later hit a Kharkiv power plant.

top.title: UK PM Burnham says Russia interfered in Brexit vote
top.description: It's the first time a British prime minister has made the claim, though Burnham offered no evidence or details.

top.title: Saudi crown prince shuttles between bunkers, WSJ reports
top.description: Mohammed bin Salman hasn't appeared publicly since Oct. 6 as Houthi strikes on Riyadh's airport killed 13 Saturday and one Sunday.

top.title: US offered Russia frozen assets for limited truce, NYT says
top.description: Envoys Witkoff and Kushner also floated a Lukoil stake sale and Belarus potash relief; Kyiv demanded matching payments and guarantees.

top.title: Djibouti migrant boat capsizes, death toll rises to 139, UN says
top.description: The Yemen-bound boat carried about 305 people, mostly Ethiopians; 84 remain missing as Djiboutian authorities continue searching, the IOM said.

top.title: State Department watchdog probes Ambassador Guilfoyle
top.description: The inquiry follows Trump donor Eric Deters' claim that Guilfoyle sought $100,000 for her credit card bill in exchange for administration access.

top.title: Pentagon raises US troop death toll in Iran war to 21
top.description: The count adds two noncombat deaths, weeks after Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth called a Washington Post undercount report "a complete lie."

top.title: Delhi Police detain thousands to foil 'Cockroach' rally
top.description: Police pulled CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke off a flight as authorities sealed Delhi against a rally demanding the election chief's resignation.

top.title: Germany rebuffs Trump, backs Zelenskyy and Russia sanctions
top.description: Foreign Minister Wadephul said Sunday that Putin needs more pressure, after Berlin vowed Saturday to keep sanctions despite Trump easing Russian diesel curbs.

top.title: Christa Pike returns to prison after surviving execution
top.description: Her attorneys say the Tennessee inmate, who survived two pentobarbital doses Sept. 30, is receiving medical care at the Nashville women's prison.

top.title: Isaias makes landfall near Destin, knocking out power
top.description: The Category 2 storm came ashore with 105 mph winds Friday night, toppling trees and leaving hundreds of thousands without power.

top.title: Putin relays Iran's peace proposal to Trump, Kremlin says
top.description: Kremlin spokesman Peskov gave no details of Tehran's terms or Trump's response, saying Ukraine dominated the Friday call.

top.title: White House orders AI firms to report security incidents
top.description: The Super Intelligence Force acted after Anthropic disclosed its test models submitted visa applications and a false Philadelphia murder tip.

top.title: US sanctions ICC itself hours after ex-judge wins Nobel
top.description: Rubio says the measures ban US transactions with the court; a six-month grace period lets member states keep funding operations.

top.title: Trump rules out Iran strikes before Nov. 3 midterms
top.description: Trump cited "productive discussions" with Tehran but said the naval blockade stays, after reports the Pentagon was drafting pre-election strike options.

top.title: Magnitude 7.7 quake topples buildings in central Panama
top.description: No casualties were immediately reported as tsunami warnings for Latin America's Pacific coast were lifted and the Panama Canal kept operating normally.

top.title: US pledges tens of millions to UN agencies in Geneva
top.description: Diplomats say the pledges to weather and wildlife agencies show Washington still wants a role in the UN despite deep funding cuts.

top.title: Justice Department halts silencer registration nationwide
top.description: The ATF guidance follows a Texas judge's August ruling against parts of the 1934 National Firearms Act, which officials didn't appeal.

top.title: AI firms plan for public revolt after catastrophic event
top.description: Anthropic and OpenAI executives are gaming out scenarios, and many insiders told Axios they expect an incident within six to 12 months.

top.title: Trump administration opposes all UN chief candidates
top.description: Washington holds a Security Council veto and wants a "disruptor" and new contenders, officials told Politico, ahead of Guterres' Dec. 31 exit.

top.title: DHS refuses to pause ICE in New York after Bronx shooting
top.description: Secretary Markwayne Mullin rejected pleas from Gov. Kathy Hochul and Mayor Zohran Mamdani after an agent shot a man near his child.

top.title: South African judge Navi Pillay wins Nobel Peace Prize
top.description: The Norwegian Nobel Committee honored the former UN human rights chief, who once defended Nelson Mandela, for promoting peace and international law.

top.title: Zelenskyy accuses US of inaction after strikes kill 78
top.description: Ukraine's president faulted Washington for pursuing business with Moscow while calling the war a stalemate, as his negotiators head to US talks.

top.title: Trump forms committee to probe Fed Governor Lisa Cook
top.description: The panel will weigh mortgage-related allegations Nov. 5 at the White House after the Supreme Court blocked Trump's earlier firing attempt.

top.title: SoftBank seeks up to $100B from Gulf investors, FT says
top.description: Masayoshi Son has held talks in the UAE about a fund to buy companies and revamp them with AI, the Financial Times reports.

top.title: Thousands march in Madrid after evicted pensioner Maricarmen's death
top.description: The 87-year-old, whose eviction sparked nationwide housing protests and a Nov. 29 snap election, died Wednesday before she could return home.

top.title: Pentagon drafts three-day Iran strike plan as Trump waits
top.description: The plans came to light the same day Trump said the U.S. won't attack Iran before the Nov. 3 midterms, citing "productive discussions."

top.title: Judge orders return of man deported to Equatorial Guinea
top.description: Trump-appointed Judge John Hinderaker ruled Ahmed Soliman's April removal violated due process; he has been jailed incommunicado after speaking out about abuse.

top.title: OpenAI revenue $20bn below earlier signals, FT reports
top.description: The report, citing documents shared with investors, sent AI-linked stocks lower Thursday, with Oracle among the hardest hit.

top.title: Trump bought SpaceX debt days before signing space policy
top.description: Filing released Thursday shows up to $5 million in SpaceX notes bought Aug. 18; the White House says Trump doesn't direct trades.

top.title: DOJ seeks indictment of Cassidy Hutchinson over Jan. 6
top.description: Prosecutors presented evidence to a grand jury Tuesday over allegations she lied to Congress, according to Punchbowl News and NBC News.

top.title: US suspends Microsoft, Adobe from green card program
top.description: Vice President Vance accused Microsoft of abusing the system, while the Labor Department also suspended Infosys, Tata, Wipro and other outsourcing firms.

top.title: USS Abraham Lincoln heads home after 321-day Iran war tour
top.description: The carrier is due at Naval Air Station North Island Thursday, a day after Hegseth gave its crew the Presidential Unit Citation.

top.title: Judge extends block on Trump's White House media ban
top.description: Judge Kelly will rule by Tuesday on keeping CNN, MS NOW and Politico's access, calling the national security defense an "uphill climb."

top.title: Rubio calls Ukraine war a stalemate, says peace elusive
top.description: The U.S. secretary of state blamed Russia's demand for all of Donetsk as a Russian diplomat said no U.S.-mediated talks are planned.

top.title: ICE amassed nearly 100 million records in voter fraud hunt
top.description: Documents released Wednesday by Democracy Forward show ICE investigators also reviewed dozens of nonprofits and weighed using undercover agents.

top.title: US charges Maduro, wife Flores with torture conspiracy
top.description: A superseding indictment unsealed in Manhattan accuses the couple of torturing opponents and Americans; a judge separately denied Flores' bail request.

top.title: Xi rebuffed Trump plea to talk with Takaichi, report says
top.description: Trump also pressed Beijing to ease rare earth curbs on Japan, but Xi warned of Japanese militarism, sources told the Post.

top.title: Hegseth gives USS Lincoln top award before homecoming
top.description: The carrier will return to San Diego Thursday after a 321-day Iran war deployment marked by reported supply shortages and crew strain.

top.title: Rubio denies US is blocking Machado's return to Venezuela
top.description: In Athens, Rubio rejected a Wall Street Journal report while the Nobel laureate vows to return after repeated blocked attempts.

top.title: ICE agent shoots man in car with child in NYC
top.description: The man was hospitalized and conscious. Mayor Mamdani says he'll demand President Trump end all ICE enforcement actions in New York City.

top.title: Ukraine's Vivaldi offensive derails Russian Donbas push
top.description: Finland's Black Bird Group says September was Russia's worst month for net territorial losses since June 2023, contradicting Putin's claims of inevitable conquest.

top.title: Gaza death toll tops 74,000 as war hits three-year mark
top.description: Gaza's Health Ministry says 1,462 were killed after the October 2025 ceasefire took effect, and UN data shows many households living in tents.

top.title: DOJ says Trump likely to reissue Harvard international student ban
top.description: A Justice Department lawyer told the 1st Circuit that White House officials signaled a new ban if the court lifts Judge Burroughs' order.

top.title: Putin adds $60B to war budget as talks stall, report says
top.description: Bloomberg's sources say Russia's 2026 defense spending will reach nearly 17 trillion rubles, about 40% above plan, after Putin decided US-brokered talks had failed.

top.title: Kagan, Soai win Nobel chemistry prize for mirror molecules
top.description: The French and Japanese chemists were honored for explaining how one mirror-image form can dominate, work the academy calls decisive for drugmaking.

top.title: Trump wants new Camp David at his West Palm Beach club
top.description: Under the plan reported by The Washington Post, the federal government would receive part of the property while the rest stays private.

top.title: Israel marks 3 years since Oct. 7 attack, weeks before vote
top.description: Survivors and bereaved families led dawn ceremonies at the Nova festival site, the first anniversary since the ceasefire with all hostages returned.

top.title: Russia strikes Kyiv hours after Zelensky's attack warning
top.description: Explosions rocked central Kyiv early Oct. 7, Putin's 74th birthday, after Ukraine's Air Force tracked Russian strategic bombers heading toward Ukraine.

top.title: Kremlin says no Trump call agreed on Siberia plague death
top.description: Trump said Tuesday he would discuss a Russian lab worker's suspected pneumonic plague death with Putin. Russia hasn't confirmed plague caused it.

top.title: US military to halt Okinawa operations, impose curfew
top.description: The 48-hour pause and alcohol ban begin Wednesday, followed by a 30-day curfew, after a Marine's arrest over a Naha woman's killing.

top.title: United, Delta recover after outage hits apps, boarding
top.description: United blamed an outside vendor for a glitch that blocked MileagePlus logins. Delta cited a global data connectivity issue that delayed boarding.

top.title: Trump weighs suspending federal gas tax before midterms
top.description: Waiving the 18.4-cent tax would require Congress to act, but lawmakers aren't expected to return before the November elections.

top.title: US moves Reaper drones from Africa to Colombia, Ecuador
top.description: Two U.S. officials said the strike drones will support an expanding anti-cartel campaign that commanders say could move from sea to land.

top.title: Large fire engulfs oil tanker off Russia's Sochi coast
top.description: Some media reports point to a possible drone attack. Russian authorities have not given a cause or said whether anyone was hurt.

top.title: Trump says nobody knows who's running Iran as talks stall
top.description: Vice President Vance echoed the uncertainty, telling Reuters any deal ending the eight-month war requires Iran to meaningfully cut nuclear enrichment.

top.title: Justice Alito says he'll stay even if Democrats win Senate
top.description: The 76-year-old justice, promoting his first book, dismissed speculation that he would retire early so Trump could confirm a conservative successor.

top.title: FBI whistleblower says White House pushed protester probe
top.description: Former FBI analyst Jill Fields says in a complaint to Senate leaders that officials ordered investigations of Los Angeles anti-ICE protesters despite free speech protections.

top.title: Sen. Murphy says Pentagon barred him from Qatar base
top.description: The Connecticut Democrat called it an effort to hide Iran war costs and said the Pentagon refused to brief him.

top.title: Judge blocks Trump's fines of up to $1.8M on migrants
top.description: A Boston judge ruled the government unlawfully penalized migrants who stayed after deportation orders, faulting vague forms and skipped public comment.

top.title: Paramount closes $110B Warner Bros. deal to form Skydance
top.description: CEO David Ellison now controls Paramount, Warner Bros., CBS, CNN and HBO Max as the combined company's shares begin trading under SKYD.

top.title: France test-fires new nuclear missile as Macron watches
top.description: The unarmed M51.3 was launched from the submarine Le Vigilant off Brittany. Macron called the test proof of France's deterrent amid Russia tensions.

top.title: Rubio assures Iceland US has no designs on the island
top.description: Opening a NATO tour, the secretary of state said Washington is open to a bigger military role, but only with Iceland's consent.

top.title: KFF poll finds record two-thirds back Medicare for All
top.description: Support has risen from 53% in 2020, and independents and Republicans account for much of the gain, less than a month before the Nov. 3 midterms.

top.title: Francis Halzen wins physics Nobel for cosmic neutrino find
top.description: The University of Wisconsin–Madison physicist leads IceCube, a South Pole detector that first spotted high-energy neutrinos arriving from beyond our galaxy.

top.title: Lithuania offers to pay for US base as Trump weighs idea
top.description: Prime Minister Mindaugas Sinkevicius said Vilnius will cover costs if Washington decides to station troops permanently, though officials say no decision exists yet.

top.title: Germany arrests ex-spy chief Hanning in espionage probe
top.description: Prosecutors allege August Hanning, who led the BND spy agency until 2005, passed political information to another country's intelligence service.

top.title: Brazil's Federal Police probe alleged US election meddling
top.description: Inquiry targets a reported $1 million US grant for Supreme Court critics as Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro head to a runoff.

top.title: Trump suggests Iran 'take out' LA, San Diego, drawing fury
top.description: Speaking in Nebraska Monday, Trump called it a "small price to pay" for the Iran war; Newsom called him "deranged and dangerous."

top.title: Justice Department files to strip 40 people of citizenship
top.description: Attorney General Todd Blanche called the filings the largest denaturalization effort in modern history, targeting naturalized citizens accused of serious crimes.

top.title: US warns Americans in Saudi Arabia of drone, missile risk
top.description: The alert comes as Houthi rebels in Yemen claim missile and drone strikes on Riyadh's main airport and an Aramco refinery.

top.title: Pentagon says it has stopped using Anthropic's AI tools
top.description: The statement came after the Pentagon missed its own late-August deadline. Sources told the BBC that Anthropic's Claude AI was still in use last week.

top.title: Reuters finds 40 LGBT migrants deported to hostile nations
top.description: The investigation comes after the Supreme Court let the Trump administration resume third-country deportations pending December arguments.
